svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"fisheries-fish-quality-inspection","label_en":"Fish quality inspection","label_is":"Gæðaskoðun fisks","section":"03","category_en":"Fisheries services, ports and cold logistics","category_is":"Þjónusta við sjávarútveg, hafnir og kælikeðja","batch":2,"tags":["fisheries","inspection"],"description":"A large inspection lens is held above a fish fillet with a long handle extending to the side.","design_note":"The magnifying lens over the actual product communicates product inspection, not a general document approval.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
